name: sparse-path-cross-attention Level-4 validation-only Pareto/maximin selector

preferred_low_no_significant_decline.gate: paired Low mean delta >= -0.005 and two-sided 95% CI upper bound >= 0; this is the first-choice tier

fallback_low_noninferiority.gate: used only when the first-choice Low tier is empty; paired mean delta >= -0.01 and one-sided 95% lower confidence bound >= -0.01

preferred_high_tail_gates.fallback_if_empty: retain all candidates in the active Low tier; never relax High mean, capacity, disabled-flow, or the active Low tier

low_baseline.comparison: paired by validation snapshot using Low NormFulFill
low_baseline.primary_gate: mean delta >= -0.005 and two-sided 95% CI upper bound >= 0
low_baseline.fallback_gate: only if the primary tier is empty: mean delta and one-sided 95% lower confidence bound must both be >= -0.01

selection.pareto: remove every candidate weakly dominated on all three Medium coordinates
selection.maximin: maximize min(metric / best eligible metric) on the Pareto front
tie_break: mean of the three normalized Medium coordinates
minimum of High P1 and P10

checkpoint_requirement: an immutable archived checkpoint whose embedded epoch matches train_history and validation files
test_data_policy: the watcher never opens evaluation/test metrics, summaries, datasets, or snapshots 400-499
